name: Spherical Harmonics Lighting Calculation
definition: Lighting is defined via real spherical harmonics with the Condon–Shortley phase. The zeroth-order coefficients are always required; higher order coefficients are optional. Each color channel has a separate coefficient, so for each degree $l$, there are $(2l + 1)$ coefficients.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Lighting Calculation computes a Gaussian's RGB color by evaluating SH coefficients against a viewing direction, distinguished by its specific Condon-Shortley phase conventions and hardcoded polynomial basis functions for degrees 0-3.
